io.milvus.common.utils.cache

Class SchemaCache

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.common.utils.cache.SchemaCache

  • public class SchemaCache
extends Object
    In-process cache for collection schemas keyed by endpoint, database, and collection name. Coalesces concurrent loads within an identity-based scope and supports capacity-bounded eviction plus per-collection and per-database invalidation.

      • getInstance

      • getOrLoad

        public DescribeCollectionResponse getOrLoad(String endpoint,
                                            String databaseName,
                                            String collectionName,
                                            boolean forceUpdate,
                                            Object loadScope,
                                            SchemaCache.Loader loader)
        Loads a schema while coalescing concurrent loads only within the same identity-based scope. Completed schemas remain shared by endpoint, database, and collection. A client should pass a stable per-client scope so another client's credentials or RPC deadline cannot control its in-flight load.
        Parameters:
        endpoint - the server endpoint
        databaseName - the database name
        collectionName - the collection name
        forceUpdate - whether to reload even when a cached schema exists
        loadScope - the identity scope for coalescing concurrent loads, must not be null
        loader - the synchronous schema loader
        Returns:
        the described collection schema

      • getOrLoadAsync

        public CompletableFuture<DescribeCollectionResponse> getOrLoadAsync(String endpoint,
                                                                    String databaseName,
                                                                    String collectionName,
                                                                    boolean forceUpdate,
                                                                    Object loadScope,
                                                                    SchemaCache.AsyncLoader loader)
        Asynchronously loads a schema with the same cache, scope, coalescing, and invalidation semantics as getOrLoad(String, String, String, boolean, Object, Loader). Cancelling one returned future does not cancel a load shared by other callers; cancelling the final waiter cancels the underlying loader.
        Parameters:
        endpoint - the server endpoint
        databaseName - the database name
        collectionName - the collection name
        forceUpdate - whether to reload even when a cached schema exists
        loadScope - the identity scope for coalescing concurrent loads, must not be null
        loader - the asynchronous schema loader
        Returns:
        a future completing with the described collection schema
